defs.def: to become smaller, fewer, weaker, etc. 减少；下降；衰弱；衰退

ex.s: It is recently reported that the number of those sticking to a traditional diet is slowly declining and around half of Britain’s consumers would like to change or improve their cooking in some way.
ex.t: 最近有报道称，坚持传统饮食的人数正在缓慢下降，约一半英国消费者想以某种方式改变或改善自己的烹饪。

ex.s: 25    , the number of snakes had declined as well.
ex.t: 25____，蛇的数量也下降了。

ex.s: The first is declining birth rates, which means old generations are large   60   （compare） to younger generations, and so, on average, the population becomes   61   （old） than before.
ex.t: 首先是出生率下降，这意味着老一代比年轻一代____60____（多），因此平均而言人口比以前更____61____（老）。

ex.s: Of   69    nineteen recognized polar bear subpopulations, three are declining, six   70   (be) stable, one is increasing, and nine lack enough data.
ex.t: 在69个已确认的北极熊亚种群中，3个在下降，6个稳定，1个在增长，9个缺乏足够数据。

ex.s: The number of trees larger than two feet across has declined by 50 percent on more than 46, 000 square miles of California forests, the new study finds.
ex.t: 一项新研究发现，在加利福尼亚州超过46,000平方英里的森林中，直径超过两英尺的大树数量已经减少了50%。

ex.s: In the Sierra high country, the number of big trees has fallen by more than 55 percent; in parts of southern California the decline was nearly 75 percent.
ex.t: 在内华达高海拔地区，大树的数量下降了超过55%；在南加州部分地区，下降幅度接近75%。

ex.s: But the amount of time spent in reading each session has declined, from closer to an hour or more to closer to a half hour per session.
ex.t: 但每次阅读所花时间下降了，从接近一小时或更多，降到接近每次半小时。

ex.s: But during the past decade declining rainfall has allowed him to plant highly profitable crops.
ex.t: 但在过去十年里，降雨量的减少使他能够种植高利润的作物。

ex.s: But while increasing health was a typical feature of the 20th century, declining birth rate could be a defining one of the 21st.
ex.t: 虽然健康水平提高是20世纪的典型特征，但出生率下降可能是21世纪的决定性特征。

ex.s: Declining birth rate is a major problem in many developing regions too, which might cause catastrophic global shortages of work force within a few decades.
ex.t: 出生率下降在许多发展中地区也是一个重大问题，可能在几十年内导致全球劳动力的灾难性短缺。

ex.s: The decline in the demand for solar energy.
ex.t: 太阳能需求的下降。

ex.s: This is when a pop star draws far more attention than, say, gradual biodiversity decline.
ex.t: 这就是当一位流行明星比，比如说，渐进的生物多样性衰退吸引更多关注时的情况。

ex.s: What was a cause of the waterfowl population decline in North America?
ex.t: 北美水禽数量下降的原因是什么？

ex.s: As the economy was in decline, some people in the town had lost their jobs.
ex.t: 由于经济衰退，镇上的一些人已经失去了工作。

ex.s: As the economy was in decline, some people in the town had lost their jobs.
ex.t: 由于经济衰退，镇上的一些人已经失去了工作。

ex.s: Many factors contributed to the decline, said Patrick Mclntyre, an ecologist who was the lead author of the study.
ex.t: 这项研究的领衔作者、生态学家帕特里克·麦金太尔说，许多因素导致了这一衰退。

ex.s: （3）What will happen if the populations of top predators in a food web greatly decline？
ex.t: （3）如果食物网中顶级捕食者的种群大幅减少，会发生什么？

ex.s: Decline of economy.
ex.t: 经济的衰退。

ex.s: A decline in the park’s income.
ex.t: 公园收入的下降。

ex.s: First, China needs to undergo rapid economic development before a population zxxk decline hits the country.
ex.t: 首先，中国需要在人口下降冲击该国之前经历快速经济发展。

ex.s: In fact, after a long period of decline, traditional crafts have recently undergone a renaissance.
ex.t: 事实上，在长期的衰退之后，传统工艺最近经历了复兴。

ex.s: Yet, within just a couple of generations, it began to mysteriously decline.
ex.t: 然而，仅仅一两代人之内，它就开始神秘地衰退。

ex.s: These lights, known as adaptive signals, have led to significant declines in both the trouble and cost of travels between work and home.
ex.t: 这些被称为自适应信号的灯，使上下班通勤的麻烦和成本都显著下降。

ex.s: The declines appeared across race, geographic, and socioeconomic lines, and in rural, urban, and suburban areas.
ex.t: 这种下降出现在不同种族、地理和社会经济层面，以及农村、城市和郊区。

ex.s: While the decline over the past decade is steep for teen readers, some data in the report shows that reading remains a big part of many children’s lives, and indicates how parents might help encourage more reading.
ex.t: 虽然过去十年青少年读者的下降幅度很大，但报告中的一些数据显示阅读仍然是许多儿童生活中的重要部分，并表明家长可能如何帮助鼓励更多阅读。

ex.s: A great decline in young work force is likely to occur in China, for instance.
ex.t: 例如，中国很可能出现年轻劳动力的大幅减少。

ex.s: Habitat loss, pesticide use, and climate change have caused dramatic declines in pollinator populations over the past couple of decades, which has damaged the US agricultural economy.
ex.t: 栖息地的丧失、杀虫剂的使用和气候变化在过去几十年中导致传粉昆虫数量急剧下降，这损害了美国农业经济。

defs.def: to refuse politely to accept or to do sth 谢绝；婉言拒绝

ex.s: Decline the job offer.
ex.t: 拒绝这份工作录用。

ex.s: Decline the job offer.
ex.t: 拒绝这份工作录用。

ex.s: All of these artists declined.
ex.t: 所有这些艺术家都拒绝了（奖项/邀请）。

ex.s: Cognitive Function May Decline As You Age
ex.t: 认知功能可能随年龄增长而衰退

ex.s: Of course, our brains can decline as we grow older for lots of reasons-including other environmental influences or genetic factors.
ex.t: 当然，随着我们年龄增长，大脑可能会因为很多原因而衰退——包括其他环境影响或遗传因素。

ex.s: Its profits will decline.
ex.t: 它的利润将会下降。

ex.s: The results are mixed For football and basketball，adding talented players to a team proves a good method，but only up to the point where 70% of the players are top talent；above that level, the team’s performance begins to decline.
ex.t: 对于足球和篮球来说，效果不一：为球队增添有天赋的球员被证明是个好办法，但仅限于70%的球员都是顶尖人才的程度；超过这一水平，球队的表现就开始下滑。

defs.def: if a noun, an adjective or a pronoun declines, it has different forms according to whether it is the subject or the object of a verb, whether it is in the singular or plural, etc. When you decline a noun, etc., you list these forms. （根据名词、形容词或代词在句中的作用）变格，使发生词形变化

ex.s: Phytoplankton play a declining role in the marine ecosystem.
ex.t: 浮游植物在海洋生态系统中扮演的作用在下降。

ex.s: In fact, the Northern Song Dynasty was in decline by this stage.
ex.t: 事实上，到这一阶段北宋已走向衰落。
